title: Miami Conclave — admin pocket log
content:
Quick summary:
- One-page scratchpad for day-of logistics, petty cash, and vendor handoffs for the Miami Conclave (Redwood booth B12).
- Intended for ops/booth leads and 2nd-line oncall. Use as single source for quick lookups.

Top reminders (TL;DR):
- All receipts must have vendor name + last4 card or cash envelope ID. Scan to expenses@redwood with subject: MIAMI-CONCLAVE | <name> | <amount>.
- Petty cash: envelope labels (PC-01..PC-05). Only use PC-02 for catering tips; others for incidental supplies.
- Booth contact (venue): Ramon Alvarez — direct: +1-305-555-0148 — vendor code: VEN-MIA-22 (needed for loading dock).

Packing / arrival notes (day-before):
- Truck ETA 06:30 local. Coordinate w/ Ramon and security. Loading dock gate closes 07:15.
- Bring extra zip-ties, gaff tape, 2x badge lanyards, spare HDMI dongle (Mac->HDMI), mini screwdriver kit.
- Booth inventory sheet attached in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-6543).

Vendor & supplier quick list (for front-line):
- Local AV rental: SoundWave Rentals (contact: Nina Cortez, nina@soundwave-mia.com, +1-305-212-7821) — pickup window 05:45–06:15.
- Badge printing backup: PrintFast Miami (contact: Jorge Ramos, jorge@printfastmiami.com, +1-305-984-0011) — always bring CSV on jump drive.
- Catering micro-orders (tips/last-minute water): Calle 8 Catering (Priya booked) — +1-305-600-4433.
- Forklift for heavy crates: DockMovers Inc (booked 07:00) — driver: Luis (text only +1-305-777-0099).

Expense / reimbursement protocol (short):
- Anything < $25: petty cash (use envelope ID printed on label).
- $25–$250: team lead prepaid card or add to post-event P-Card expense report (attach receipt).
- >$250: pre-approve via JIRA-EVENTS-321 (create ticket, tag @Maya).
- Taxis/ride shares: use company rides account where possible; otherwise keep receipt + capture driver name.
- Meal per-diem guideline: $60/day US market (note for finance: code EXP-GTM-TRAVEL).

Receipt scanning rules (quick):
- Scan with phone before discarding. Filename format: MIAMI-YYYYMMDD_<initials>_<amt>.jpg (e.g., MIAMI-20260302_JP_37.42.jpg).
- Upload to Drive->shared_drives/go-to-market/events/miami/consolidated/receipts or attach to expense email.

Sample quick expense log (copy into expense upload CSV later):
- Date, Name, CardType, Amount, Currency, Vendor, EnvelopeID, Notes
- 2026-03-02, Jordan Patel, Cash, 15.00, USD, Lopez Supplies, PC-03, "Cable ties / gaff"
- 2026-03-02, Priya Desai, P-Card, 142.50, USD, Calle 8 Catering, , "Box lunches (team)"

Booth handoff + teardown protocol:
- Teardown lead: Liam O'Connor (call if gate issues). Pack heavy items in crate order 1..4 (see crate labels).
- Before handing to carrier: photograph crate seals, log seal ID in the teardown sheet, get carrier phone and name.
- If carrier delayed >30 mins, escalate to Ramon and file incident note in JIRA-EVENTS-321.

On-call rota (phone numbers masked on shared doc; below for pocket):
- Day 0 (setup): Jordan P. (primary) — mobile +1-415-555-0190
- Day 1 (show): Priya D. (primary) — mobile +1-646-555-0124
- Backup/float: Maya S. — mobile +1-206-555-0299

Parking / validation hacks:
- Venue validation ticket needed for vendors. Save barcode in phone and hand to onsite staff. Ask security for vendor lot map (Ramon will email).

Loose TODO (actionable, front-line):
- [ ] Print 20 extra name badges (backup CSV in GH PR #87).
- [ ] Reconcile petty cash envelopes by Day+1 and drop sealed receipts in Finance lockbox on ground floor.
- [ ] Confirm forklift driver arrival time + send confirmation SMS.
- [ ] Bring marker pens for crate IDs (permanent marker).

Notes to self / unresolved questions (frag):
- Confirm whether venue accepts Apple Pay for last-minute supply purchases (ask Ramon).
- Is there a secure overnight storage option for the demo laptops? Confluence thread unclear.
- Who owns insurance claim if a demo unit is damaged in transit (Ops vs. Logistics vendor)? File question in JIRA-EVENTS-321 and tag @legal if unresolved.

Reimbursement tips for team (short bullet):
- Always forward digital receipts to expenses@redwood within 5 days.
- For shared meals: list attendees in receipt notes (names + team).
- Mark receipts that include personal items with a leading * in filename and annotate amount split.

Packing checklist (brief):
- Laptop + chargers x3, demo HDMI adapter, clicker, power strips, cable ties, gaffer tape, spare phone charger, badge lanyards x25, cash petty envelopes PC-01..PC-05, business cards x200, hand sanitizer, wet wipes.

Quick links: 
- Confluence event page: CONFLUENCE-6543
- JIRA runbook/incidents: JIRA-EVENTS-321
- Asset PR for printables: https://github.com/redwoodinc/event-assets/pull/87
- Slack channel (onsite): #events-miami (slack link above)

End-of-day checklist (for booth lead):
- Count and seal petty cash. Photo envelope with seal number.
- Run inventory against crate checklist. Note missing items immediately.
- Quick retro note in Slack channel: 3 bullets (what went well / what to improve / urgent follow-ups).

Last-minute phone list (full numbers in contacts doc; pocket list only):
- Venue ops: Ramon Alvarez — +1-305-555-0148
- AV: Nina Cortez (SoundWave) — +1-305-212-7821
- Print backup: Jorge Ramos (PrintFast) — +1-305-984-0011
- Forklift driver (DockMovers): Luis — +1-305-777-0099

If anything breaks: take photo, do small fix if safe, otherwise tag @Liam in Slack and raise JIRA ticket with photos.

-- notes end --

(leave this doc as the single-pocket reference; after event, migrate items under "shared_drives/go-to-market/events/miami/postmortem" and change status->final)
